climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A red wine region in Hungary, linked to neighboring Burgenland in Austria by geography, culture and viticulture. Kékfrankos is the main grape, and Blaufränkisch covers 53% of plantings. Wine here dates back to Roman times.
